primitives.summary: Single resume content contract: shape, safe links, PDF path, safe JSON keys and size limit, shared by Convex, the dashboard and the publication build.

guarantees.statement: content.upsertResumeDraft rejects contentJson that fails the contract with a ConvexError before any write.
guarantees.verifiedBy: apps/backend/convex/model/content/resume.ts#upsertResumeDraftHandler calls parseResumePageContent before ctx.db; private probe pr1-resume (aohys-primitives-20261013)

guarantees.statement: The dashboard editor and scripts/apply-dashboard-published-content.ts validate with the same contract; no other resume validator exists.

primitives.summary: One as-const array per domain vocabulary (locale, environment, release environment, lead intent/status/contact path, publication scope/request/attempt state, media provider/usage/status, site setting key/classification, environment variable classification, writable media providers, case-study status/evidence); types derive from the arrays and Convex validators derive through literals().

guarantees.statement: No production source outside packages/core/src/domain.ts declares a string union, array or v.union that copies a domain vocabulary, including stale copies (a value missing) and drifted copies (a value added); a line ending in // domain-vocabulary-ok marks a different concept.
guarantees.verifiedBy: pnpm architecture:fitness (domain-vocabulary-redeclared); probes for identical, stale and drifted copies rejected

guarantees.statement: The Convex schema and function validators for these vocabularies derive from the domain arrays.
content.upsertSiteSetting accepts only keys in SITE_SETTING_KEYS (argument validator).
